architecture: Unchanged existing three-reader small response head; AVI adds only three zero-initialized hidden input columns. Author readers stay frozen.
AVI_comparison: Same rows, common shared initial parameters, actual batches, loss, update count and seeds. Inputs are exact-allele permissive composite AVI; not experimental truth.
confidence_check: For outer-held-source development checks, train error models only on other sources original calibration-region predictions from that same outer-source-omitted base model. Divide those whole regions into error fit and error scale. Do not use outer source to fit either stage.

primary_tests: Siraj2026 OL33 held-library macro across three known lines
new_test_protocol.bootstrap_unit: Fixed 1Mb genomic windows; not ancestry-specific LD blocks.
new_test_protocol.unknown_blood_lines: Report raw diagnostics separately; no authorized predictions or validated cell-specific differences.
new_test_protocol.same_paper_OL27_reserved_cases: Descriptive only, never substitute for independent publication.
